name: OSS_PARTIES
description: Parties table stores the parties information for the subscription.

columns.name: PARTY_ROLE
columns.description: The role of the party selected for the subscriptiont. The role can be internal or external.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the party selected for the subscription. FK to HZ_PARTIES or  PER_PERSONS

columns.name: SIGNED_BY
columns.description: Capture the name of the person signing the subscription. Must have a value if subscription default requires a signature. Will be editable only once the subscription is approved.

columns.name: SIGNED_DATE
columns.description: Captures the date when subscription is signed.

columns.name: PRIMARY_YN
columns.description: The flag that indicates if the external party on the subscription is the primary party or not

columns.name: INTERNAL_YN
columns.description: The flag that indicates if the external party on the subscription isinternal  or not

columns.name: SIGNER_ROLE
columns.description: The party is internal or not.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
